Two fictional patients with Helioxa cough
Fictional journal — synthetic case for software testing. DOI: 10.0000/fake.case
Abstract
Patient A, 12-year-old fictional child, cough after Helioxa. Patient B, 33-year-old fictional
man, same product, hemoptysis one episode. Two distinct cases in one article.
